text:
Home > Stock Picks > Stocks to Buy > How to Profit From Wall Street’s Recent Rejection of Tesla Inc Stock Jun 6, 2018, 12:10 am EDT June 6, 2018 How to Profit From Wall Street’s Recent Rejection of Tesla Inc Stock Profiting on TSLA stock entails knowing the key levels to watch Source: JD Lasica via Wikimedia Commons
Tesla Inc (NASDAQ: TSLA ) is a contentious stock to say the least. Emotions run high in the name, so it definitely is a momentum stock. These are usually hard to trade. When they fall, they look like they are headed into an abyss. Catching the proverbial knife may end up being a machete that costs investors digits.
On Tuesday, TSLA stock fell 1.9% on lingering fears that Elon Musk’s position of control was in jeopardy. There are some investors who want to strip Mr. Musk of his chairmanship. If this happens, I think it would be a mistake, because it would put a giant hole in the bull thesis for TSLA. Musk Is the Face of TSLA Stock
The reason that Tesla stock commands such a high valuation is that Wall Street is totally enamored with Musk — and that is crucial to its operation. The company depends on the ability to borrow. Musk can spin capital raises as a good thing, so he has been able to finance the company’s forays so far. If this stops, then TSLA’s cash infusions may become scarce and thereby weaken its operation.
This is not a knock against the company. In fact, I’ve been on record for over a while saying that the bullish thesis in TSLA has many prongs and this makes it a tough stock to short. The bears need several years to kill all facets of the bullish thesis.
No, I am not a perma-bull on TSLA stock. Go back a few years and you will see that I was extremely negative on its outlook. I still am, but I don’t see doom for at least a year.
Of late, Musk has had a few strange outbursts on Twitter and even one during the earnings call . That was a strange situation that was completely avoidable. A Bullish Trade
The arguments on both sides of the TSLA stock debate are valid, so this creates incredible tension. This benefits premium sellers provided they find proper levels. Today I am sharing a bullish trade but one that doesn’t even need a rally to profit. I merely bet on scenarios that are not likely to happen.
Instead of risking $285 per share without any room for error I will use TSLA options where I can build a proper buffer so I can better sleep at night, especially when stock markets are near or at all-time highs.
The key to winning with my method is picking the right levels. Click here for a video that explains the important TSLA levels in play here. What to Watch with TSLA Stock
I do have a cautionary note about being short TSLA puts. The fact that Musk is such an integral part of the TSLA thesis makes him a giant liability. If we get a headline that Musk is leaving, then the stock will immediately crash and all bets would be off.
I know he said that he is committed to Tesla, but he can’t control every variable. I offer the situation in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ: AAPL ), except I believe that Musk is more important to TSLA short-term than Steve Jobs was to Apple.
Before you send in the hate mail, I believe that AAPL will eventually suffer from losing Jobs, but not before it milks his beautiful setup.
Nicolas Chahine is the managing director of SellSpreads.com . As of this writing, he did not hold a position in any of the aforementioned securities. You can follow him as @racernic on twitter and stocktwits .
